input_provider.label: Voice input provider
input_provider.description: Used by everyone on this site.

max_recording_seconds.label: Recording limit
max_recording_seconds.description: 10–1800 seconds. Recording stops at the limit; the selected provider's limit also applies.

max_concurrent_per_user.label: Concurrent requests per user
max_concurrent_per_user.description: Simultaneous speech requests per user, from 1 to 8.

deepseek_tts_enabled.label: Read aloud
deepseek_tts_enabled.description: Allow users to play spoken replies.

deepseek_asr_credentials_source.label: Connection
deepseek_asr_credentials_source.description: Reuse the service URL and API Key from DeepSeek read aloud.

deepseek_asr_base_url.label: Service URL
deepseek_asr_base_url.description: Uses the official DeepSeek endpoint by default.

deepseek_asr_api_key.label: API Key
deepseek_asr_api_key.description: Leave blank to keep the saved key.

deepseek_tts_credentials_source.label: Connection
deepseek_tts_credentials_source.description: Reuse the service URL and API Key from voice input.

deepseek_tts_base_url.label: Service URL
deepseek_tts_base_url.description: Uses the official DeepSeek endpoint by default.

deepseek_tts_api_key.label: API Key
deepseek_tts_api_key.description: Leave blank to keep the saved key.

mimo_base_url.label: Service URL
mimo_base_url.description: Uses the official MiMo endpoint by default.

mimo_api_key.label: API Key
mimo_api_key.description: Leave blank to keep the saved key.

charge_asr.label: Charge for voice input
charge_asr.description: Free by default. Enable to charge users at the configured rate.

asr_cny_per_hour.label: Voice input rate
asr_cny_per_hour.description: CNY per hour of audio, rounded up to whole seconds.

charge_tts.label: Charge for read aloud
charge_tts.description: Free by default. Enable to charge users at the configured rate.

tts_cny_per_10000_characters.label: Read aloud rate
tts_cny_per_10000_characters.description: CNY per 10,000 billable characters. Chinese characters count as 2.
